_comment: Curated event-driven discovery feeds. All verified live on 2026-05-11 with `curl -L --max-time 5`. Each entry: feed_url + role for human reviewers. Vendors without an RSS feed (Anthropic, Mistral) are intentionally NOT here — they get caught via the HN search feed and the per-subreddit feeds. To add a feed, run the probe loop in PR description and confirm 200.
